nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Ecological regulations_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What challenge is highlighted regarding government management in the context of ecological environment protection and economic development?
nodes.answer: The government cannot effectively manage the ecological environment and promote high-quality economic development solely through laws and regulations.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Partnerships for the goals|Global sustainability regulation|Ecological regulations_qna_002
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is the purpose of the European Commission's Directorate-General for Environment?
nodes.answer: The purpose of the European Commission's Directorate-General for Environment is to develop and implement EU policies on the environment with the goal of ensuring a high level of environmental protection and sustainability.
